name: STEMROBO TECHNOLOGIES LIMITED
india_angle: STEMROBO Technologies is an Indian Edtech company specializing in setting up labs in K-12 schools across India.
summary: STEMROBO Technologies Limited focuses on providing educational solutions for K-12 schools, including setting up STEM, AI, IoT, and AR/VR labs. Their primary aim is to equip students with 21st-century skills through hands-on learning and innovative lab setups.
